verdict.rationale: LlamaParse offers a REST API, CLI, and SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go/Java) suitable for scripted/CI use, plus webhooks for async job notification instead of polling, which supports headless automation workflows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD examples (GitHub Actions, Docker recipes), documented non-interactive auth/service-account flow for pipelines, and independent hands-on confirmation of headless CI usage.
